recalled_knowledge.item: nEXO-class enriched 136Xe inventory ~5 t as the size reference for a hypothetical enriched TPC
Gamma-Poisson conjugacy: flat prior + one observed event gives Gamma(2,1) for the rate; predictive for zero events (1+k)^-alpha (negative binomial)
Jeffreys prior for a Poisson mean is Gamma(1/2) -> Gamma(1.5) after one count
Asimov median significance Z = sqrt(2((s+b)ln(1+s/b)-s)); exact Poisson counting significance Z = Phi^-1(1 - P(>=n|b))

failed_or_abandoned: First implementation of the first-crossing toys drew all N ~ Poisson(mu_total) arrival positions per toy (arrays up to 20 000 x 2000 for XLZD at delta = 380 keV); it exceeded 300 s and was stopped. Replaced by drawing only the first 30 arrivals of a unit-rate Poisson process in cumulative-mean space (exact for the first crossing, since no configuration needs more than 5 events for 5 sigma).
np.quantile on arrays containing inf ('never crosses') returned NaN medians; replaced by an inf-safe quantile helper.
A 'world' row that counted XLZD in the 200-270 keV window was replaced by XLZD always using its 400 keV ROI.
P081 (posterior-predictive framework) and P072 (exothermic follow-up) do not exist in output/papers; own Gamma-Poisson predictive used instead, P058 used for the exothermic branch.
Dataviz JS palette validator not run (PAPER_GUIDE rule); the skill's validated default categorical palette was used as documented.
